description_en: ApsaraVideo VOD issues the upload URL and upload credential to ensure authorization and security and prevent malicious uploads. During issuance, a media ID (MediaId), also called a video ID (VideoId), undergoes automatic creation for management. Invoke this operation to obtain the upload URL and upload credential, and create audio or video information
description_zh: 点播服务下发上传地址和凭证以保障授权和安全，防止恶意上传，并在下发时自动创建媒体ID（MediaId），也叫视频ID（VideoId）用于管理。通过调用本接口可获取上传所需地址和凭证，并创建音视频信息
kebab_example: aliyun vod create-upload-video --file-name D:_video_01.mp4 --title UploadTest --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUploadVideo

parameters.help_en: The URL of the custom video thumbnail
parameters.help_zh: 自定义视频封面的URL地址
parameters.name: cover_url

parameters.help_en:
The description of the audio or video file displayed in ApsaraVideo VOD after the upload is complete.

The description can be up to 1024 characters in length.
The value is encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
上传完成后，在点播中展示的音/视频描述。

长度不超过1024个字符。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The address of the audio or video source file to be uploaded.

The file name extension is required and is not case-sensitive.
For supported file name extensions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55396.html
parameters.help_zh:
待上传的音/视频源文件地址。

必须带扩展名，且扩展名不区分大小写。
支持的扩展名，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55396.html
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The size of the audio or video source file to be uploaded. Unit: bytes
parameters.help_zh: 待上传的音/视频源文件的大小。单位：字节
parameters.name: file_size

parameters.help_en:
The title of the audio or video file displayed in ApsaraVideo VOD after the upload is complete.

The title can be up to 128 characters in length.
The value is encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
上传完成后，在点播中展示的音/视频标题。

长度不超过128个字符。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en:
The category ID. You can obtain the category ID by using one of the following methods:

Log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Configuration Management > Media Management Configuration > Category Management to view the category ID.
When you create a category by calling the [AddCategory](~~AddCategory~~) operation, the category ID is the value of the CateId parameter in the response.
When you query categories by calling the [GetCategories](~~GetCategories~~) operation, the category ID is the value of the CateId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh:
分类ID。可通过以下方式获取：

登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择配置管理 > 媒资管理配置 > 分类管理查看分类ID。
通过[AddCategory](~~AddCategory~~)接口创建分类时，分类ID为返回参数CateId的值。
通过[GetCategories](~~GetCategories~~)接口查询分类时，为请求后返回参数CateId的值
parameters.name: cate_id

parameters.help_en:
The tags of the audio or video file.

You can specify up to 16 tags.
To specify multiple tags, separate them with commas (,).
Each tag can be up to 32 characters in length.
The value is encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
音/视频标签。

最多不超过16个标签。
如需设置多个音/视频标签，请使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
单个标签不超过32个字符或汉字。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en:
The custom settings in a JSON string. The settings support message callbacks, upload acceleration, and other configurations. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html.

To use the message callback in this parameter, you must configure an HTTP callback URL and select the corresponding callback event types in the console. Otherwise, the callback settings do not take effect. If no callback URL is specified for subsequent tasks, callbacks are sent to this address by default. To configure HTTP callbacks in the console, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86071.html.
To use the upload acceleration feature, you must submit a Yida form (https://yida.alibaba-inc.com/o/ticketapply) to apply for activation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55396.html
parameters.help_zh:
自定义设置。为JSON字符串，支持消息回调、上传加速等设置。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html。

此参数中消息回调的使用前提是需要在控制台配置HTTP回调地址和勾选对应的回调事件类型才能使用，否则回调设置不生效。同时后续任务未指定回调地址时，均默认推送至此地址。控制台配置HTTP回调的操作，请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86071.html。
如需使用上传加速功能，您需要填写宜搭信息 (https://yida.alibaba-inc.com/o/ticketapply)申请开通，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55396.html
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the transcoding template group. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
Log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Configuration Management > Media Processing Configuration > Transcoding Template Groups to view the transcoding template group ID.
When you create a transcoding template group by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102665.html operation, the transcoding template group ID is the value of the TranscodeTemplateGroupId parameter in the response.
When you query transcoding template groups by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102669.html operation, the transcoding template group ID is the value of the TranscodeTemplateGroupId parameter in the response.

If both WorkflowId and TemplateGroupId are specified, WorkflowId takes precedence.
If this parameter is not specified, the default transcoding template group is used for transcoding. If a transcoding template group ID is specified, the specified template group is used for transcoding.
If this parameter is set to the built-in No Transcoding template group, only the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55630.html event notification is sent after the audio or video file is uploaded. The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55636.html event notification is not sent.
This parameter triggers an https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027551.html. After submission, the task is not immediately completed and is queued for asynchronous execution in the background.
To ensure normal playback, when the built-in No Transcoding template group is used, only the following formats support direct playback without transcoding after the audio or video file is uploaded: MP4, FLV, MP3, M3U8, and WEBM. Other formats support storage only (check the file name extension of FileName). If you use ApsaraVideo Player, the player version must be 3.1.0 or later
parameters.help_zh:
转码模板组ID。可通过以下方式获取：
登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择配置管理 > 媒体处理配置 > 转码模板组查看转码模板组ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102665.html接口创建转码模板组时，转码模板组ID为返回参数TranscodeTemplateGroupId的值。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102669.html接口查询转码模板组时，为请求后返回参数TranscodeTemplateGroupId的值。

如果同时传递了WorkflowId和TemplateGroupId，以WorkflowId为准。
若不传入本参数，则按默认的转码模板组进行转码；若传入了转码模板组ID时，则按指定的模板组进行转码。
若设置为系统内置的不转码模板组，则音视频上传后，仅有https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55630.html的事件通知，没有https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55636.html的事件通知。
该参数任务为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027551.html，提交后任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行。
为确保正常播放，当设置为系统内置的不转码模板组，则视音频上传完成后，仅以下格式支持不转码直接播放：MP4、FLV、MP3、M3U8、WEBM，其他格式仅支持存储（关注FileName的扩展名）；若使用阿里云播放器播放，则版本须为3.1.0或以上
parameters.name: template_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The workflow ID. Log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Configuration Management > Media Processing Configuration > Workflow Management to view the workflow ID.

If both WorkflowId and TemplateGroupId are specified, WorkflowId takes precedence. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115347.html.
This parameter triggers an https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027551.html. After submission, the task is not immediately completed and is queued for asynchronous execution in the background
parameters.help_zh:
工作流ID。可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择配置管理 > 媒体处理配置 > 工作流管理查看工作流ID。

如果同时传递了WorkflowId和TemplateGroupId，以WorkflowId为准。使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115347.html。
该参数任务为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027551.html，提交后任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行
parameters.name: workflow_id

parameters.help_en:
The storage address. You can obtain the storage address by using the following method:
Log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Configuration Management > Media Management Configuration > Storage Management to view the storage address.

If this parameter is not specified, the audio or video file is uploaded to the default storage address. If no default storage address exists, the file is uploaded to the first storage address in the storage list. If this parameter is specified, the audio or video file is uploaded to the specified storage address
parameters.help_zh:
存储地址。可通过以下方式获取：
登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择配置管理 > 媒资管理配置 > 存储管理查看存储地址。

若不传此参数，则音视频文件上传至默认的存储地址上（无默认存储地址时上传至存储列表第一个存储地址）；若传入此参数，则音视频文件上传至该指定的存储地址上
parameters.name: storage_location

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Default value: app-1000000. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。默认取值：app-1000000。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The custom ID. Only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores are supported. The length is 6 to 64 characters. The ID is unique at the user level
parameters.help_zh: 自定义 ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一
parameters.name: reference_id

UploadAddress.description_en:
The upload URL.

The upload URL returned by this operation is a Base64-encoded value. When you use an SDK or API to upload media assets, you must Base64-decode the value before use. Only uploads by using the native OSS SDK or OSS API require you to parse UploadAddress
UploadAddress.description_zh:
上传地址。

接口返回的上传地址是Base64加密后的值。调用SDK或API完成媒资上传时需要对其进行Base64解码后再使用。仅OSS原生SDK或OSS API方式上传需要自行解析UploadAddress

UploadAuth.description_en:
The upload credential.

The upload credential returned by this operation is a Base64-encoded value. When you use an SDK or API to upload media assets, you must Base64-decode the value before use. Only uploads by using the native OSS SDK or OSS API require you to parse UploadAuth
UploadAuth.description_zh:
上传凭证。

接口返回的上传凭证是Base64加密后的值。调用SDK或API完成媒资上传时需要对其进行Base64解码后再使用。仅OSS原生SDK或OSS API方式上传需要自行解析UploadAuth

VideoId.description_en: The audio or video ID. This ID can be used as a request parameter for media asset management, media processing, and content moderation operations
VideoId.description_zh: 音/视频ID。可作为媒资管理、媒体处理、媒体审核等接口的请求参数
